name: R2B Partial COD Lite for WooCommerce
author: round2begins

sections.description:
Partial COD Lite for WooCommerce enables store owners to accept a small advance payment online and collect the remaining balance upon delivery.

This helps reduce fake orders, RTO (Return to Origin) losses, and improves customer trust.
It’s simple, flexible, and works with any payment gateway.

Upgrade to the Pro version for:
– Percentage or fixed advance configuration
– Extra COD charge support
– Customizable labels and messages
– Block-based checkout compatibility
– Priority support and updates

👉 Upgrade to Pro to unlock these features.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/partial-cod-lite-for-woocommerce/ or install via WordPress Plugin Installer.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce → Settings → Payments → Partial COD Lite to configure your options.
sections.faq:
Does it work with all payment gateways?

Yes, the plugin is payment-gateway independent. It only requires that you have at least one online payment method active for the advance payment.

Is it compatible with WooCommerce blocks (new checkout)?

The Lite version supports classic checkout. The Pro version supports block-based checkout.

Can I customize the advance amount or add extra charges?

Those options are available in the Pro version.
